1 figure = 1 person killed1 figure = 1 person woundedfaded = local / regional coverage onlyGroups = 22 events (23 indexed reports; Oct 25 store shooting is 2 reports, Apr 7 White Water Rd had nobody reported hit)
What counts as national: an outlet or database whose audience is the whole U.S. — national wire services, national networks and papers, national trackers / compilations, and national niche or trade sites. Not counted: local, Tallahassee or Atlanta stations, statewide outlets (Patch Georgia, GBI), and Gray TV affiliates in other states that re-ran a WALB story. Strict reading: no 2026 Lowndes shooting reached a general national newsroom (AP, CNN, networks, NYT, WaPo, USA Today — row 31); 1 of 22 counts if niche sites are excluded (May 3, trackers only).
